name: BLENDING_MODES table (bleh)
plain: The largest blend table read: lerp and scaled lerps, sign-preserving forms, inject, CFG-style, image modes, slices, probabilistic picks, cosine-similarity, orthogonal and wavelet modes. BlendMode can rescale t or normalise. BlehLatentBlend exposes all of them. Image-style modes are applied to raw latent values, so thresholds like a<0.5 have no image meaning there.
math:
examples:
inject a+t·b; cfg_base_a a+t(a−b); inject_difference same form
lerpNNNx lerp·k; lerp_copysign_a sign(a)·|lerp|; avoidsign uses −a
multiply (a·t)(b·t) normalised; difference |a−b|·t; exclusion (a+b−2ab)t; colordodge a/(1−b+1e−6)
overlay branches on torch.all(b<0.5) (whole tensor, not per value)
hardlight per value on a<0.5

providers.author: blepping
providers.note: wavelet_cfg and latent operations reuse similar machinery; not read in full
